source.quote: -הנסחרים בארץ 0.150% 3700ש

rate.notes: '0.150% לרבעון'. Note 3: charged in the month after the quarter on the value of the securities on the last day of the quarter, prorated by holding days; on a sale/redemption/transfer during the quarter it is charged that day on the relevant value. Note 2: may not be charged on makam or on a money-market fund as defined in the 1994 assets regulations (recorded as excludes). Note 8: in the first year after a securities deposit is opened in the mobile app the client pays at most 50% of the printed price. Note 6: the fee may not exceed 30% of the transaction proceeds. Note 1: not chargeable on delisted securities (with an exception). Note 8 is an offer, not the price: it binds only for a deposit opened in the mobile app and only for its first year ('במהלך השנה הראשונה לאחר פתיחת פיקדון כאמור על ידי לקוח באפליקציה הסלולרית... שלא יעלה על 50%'), so it is in left_out. Leumi's 2026 campaigns waived this fee for new joiners for a year ('פטור מדמי ניהול בשנה הראשונה', joining to 31.03.26; and to 31.8.26 against a 4% deposit of 50,000 NIS), both closed, both 'הבנק רשאי לשנות... או להפסיקם בכל עת' (left_out). What customers actually paid, not a price: Leumi's own distribution sheet for 1.1-30.6.2026 prints Israeli custody at an annual 0.06% to 0.27% of the deposit by portfolio size (library 3028da0eb5998d11), against 0.6% a year here; the exchange's sheet shows the same averages. Value unchanged (D56).
